narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The evangelist Luke, telling the story evenly and gravely.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord: calm authority, sorrowful in the Passion, serene after rising.

disciples.name: The disciples
disciples.note: The apostles speaking together: questioning, eager, bewildered.

peter-and-john.name: Peter and John
peter-and-john.note: The two apostles sent to prepare the pasch, asking for directions.

peter.name: Peter
peter.note: Simon Peter: fervent at supper, frightened and defensive in the courtyard.

servant-girl.name: Servant maid
servant-girl.note: A maid of the high priest's house, pointing Peter out by the fire.

a-bystander.name: A bystander
a-bystander.note: A man at the fire in the courtyard who accuses Peter.

another-bystander.name: Another bystander
another-bystander.note: A second man at the fire, insisting Peter is a Galilean.

guards.name: The guards
guards.note: The men holding Jesus overnight, jeering as they strike him.

council-members.name: Members of the council
council-members.note: The ancients, chief priests and scribes: hostile, accusing, mocking.

1.t: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the pasch, was at hand.

2.t: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put Jesus to death: but they feared the people.

3.t: And Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariot, one of the twelve.

4.t: And he went and discoursed with the chief priests and the magistrates, how he might betray him to them.

5.t: And they were glad and covenanted to give him money.

6.t: And he promised. And he sought opportunity to betray him in the absence of the multitude.

7.t: And the day of the unleavened bread came, on which it was necessary that the pasch should be killed.

8.t: And he sent Peter and John, saying:
Go, and prepare for us the pasch, that we may eat.

9.t: Where wilt thou that we prepare?

10.t: Behold, as you go into the city, there shall meet you a man carrying a pitcher of water: follow him into the house where he entereth in.

11.t: And you shall say to the goodman of the house: The master saith to thee: Where is the guest chamber, where I may eat the pasch with my disciples?

12.t: And he will shew you a large dining room, furnished. And there prepare.

13.t: And they going, found as he had said to them and made ready the pasch.

14.t: And when the hour was come, he sat down: and the twelve apostles with him.

15.t: With desire I have desired to eat this pasch with you, before I suffer.

16.t: For I say to you that from this time I will not eat it, till it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

17.t: And having taken the chalice, he gave thanks and said:
Take and divide it among you.

18.t: For I say to you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, till the kingdom of God come.

19.t: And taking bread, he gave thanks and brake and gave to them, saying:
This is my body, which is given for you. Do this for a commemoration of me.

20.t: In like manner, the chalice also, after he had supped, saying:
This is the chalice, the new testament in my blood, which shall be shed for you.

21.t: But yet behold: the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

22.t: And the Son of man indeed goeth, according to that which is determined: but yet, woe to that man by whom he shall be betrayed.

23.t: And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

24.t: And there was also a strife amongst them, which of them should seem to be the greater.

25.t: The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and they that have power over them are called beneficent.

26.t: But you not so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger: and he that is the leader, as he that serveth.

27.t: For which is greater, he that sitteth at table or he that serveth? Is not he that sitteth at table? But I am in the midst of you, as he that serveth.

28.t: And you are they who have continued with me in my temptations:

29.t: And I dispose to you, as my Father hath disposed to me, a kingdom;

30.t: That you may eat and drink at my table, in my kingdom: and may sit upon thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

31.t: Simon, Simon, behold Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat.

32.t: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and thou, being once converted, confirm thy brethren.

33.t: Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison and to death.

34.t: I say to thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, till thou thrice deniest that thou knowest me.

35.t: When I sent you without purse and scrip and shoes, did you want anything?

36.t: But now he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise a scrip: and he that hath not, let him sell his coat and buy a sword.

37.t: For I say to you that this that is written must yet be fulfilled in me. And with the wicked was he reckoned. For the things concerning me have an end.

38.t: Lord, behold, here are two swords.

39.t: And going out, he went, according to his custom, to the Mount of Olives. And his disciples also followed him.

40.t: And when he was come to the place, he said to them:
Pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

41.t: And he was withdrawn away from them a stone's cast. And kneeling down, he prayed.

42.t: Father, if thou wilt, remove this chalice from me: but yet not my will, but thine be done.

43.t: And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him. And being in an agony, he prayed the longer.

44.t: And his sweat became as drops of blood, trickling down upon the ground.

45.t: And when he rose up from prayer and was come to the disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow.

46.t: Why sleep you? Arise: pray: lest you enter into temptation.

47.t: As he was yet speaking, behold a multitude; and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them and drew near to Jesus, for to kiss him.

48.t: Judas, dost thou betray the Son of man with a kiss?

49.t: And they that were about him, seeing what would follow, said to him:
Lord, shall we strike with the sword?

50.t: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

51.t: And when he had touched his ear, he healed him.

52.t: And Jesus said to the chief priests and magistrates of the temple and the ancients, that were come unto him:
Are ye come out, as it were against a thief, with swords and clubs?

53.t: When I was daily with you in the temple, you did not stretch forth your hands against me: but this is your hour and the power of darkness.

54.t: And apprehending him, they led him to the high priest's house. But Peter followed afar off.

55.t: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall and were sitting about it, Peter was in the midst of them.

56.t: Whom when a certain servant maid had seen sitting at the light and had earnestly beheld him, she said:
This man also was with him.

58.t: And after a little while, another seeing him, said:
Thou also art one of them.

59.t: And after the space, as it were of one hour, another certain man affirmed, saying:
Of a truth, this man was also with him: for he is also a Galilean.

60.t: Man, I know not what thou sayest.
And immediately, as he was yet speaking, the cock crew.

61.t: And the Lord turning looked on Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, as he had said:
Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny thrice.
61.q: the word of Jesus as Peter remembers it; could stay with the narrator

62.t: And Peter going out, wept bitterly.

63.t: And the men that held him mocked him and struck him.

64.t: And they blindfolded him and smote his face. And they asked him saying:
Prophesy: Who is it that struck thee?

65.t: And blaspheming, many other things they said against him.

66.t: And as soon as it was day, the ancients of the people and the chief priests and scribes came together. And they brought him into their council saying:
If thou be the Christ, tell us.

67.t: If I shall tell you, you will not believe me.

68.t: And if I shall also ask you, you will not answer me, nor let me go.

69.t: But hereafter the Son of man shall be sitting on the right hand of the power of God.

70.t: Art thou then the Son of God?

71.t: What need we any further testimony? For we ourselves have heard it from his own mouth.
